title: Fix the E′ round-5 review findings: bind Git Credential Manager's store for the launched helper, de-duplicate cleanup reports by controller, gate the Unix runner to macOS and Linux
outcome: Fix the E′ round-5 review findings: bind Git Credential Manager's store for the launched helper, de-duplicate cleanup reports by controller, gate the Unix runner to macOS and Linux
acceptance: When an admitted Git Credential Manager helper (manager or manager-core) is used, the transport Git process and its helpers run with the credential store the target capture admitted bound in their environment (for example GCM_CREDENTIAL_STORE set to the captured non-cache store), so a configuration change after capture cannot make GCM start its cache daemon during the exchange; where the effective store cannot be bound, the exchange is refused before spawn with a refusal naming the setting and its remedy. A test shows a cache store configured after capture is not used by the launched helper (or is refused).

A foreground deadline or cleanup failure and the drained cleanup outcome of the same controller are reported once: the CLI correlates them by controller identity rather than by equal detail text, and reports the Deadline with one cleanup outcome. A test covers the case where the drained detail differs from the foreground one.

The Unix session controller and its rustix waitid launch imports compile only on macOS and Linux; every other target, OpenBSD included, builds and reaches the existing UnsupportedPlatform refusal. Shown at least by cfg structure that a non-macOS/Linux Unix target never names waitid, WaitId or WaitIdOptions, and by the existing three-platform builds.
Optional, from the Claude Notes: UnixLaunch and Cleanup details print a bare OS error number (or omit the clause) instead of Some(n)/None.
Strict clippy and the focused tests covering these changes pass on Windows, macOS and Linux on one exact candidate commit whose sole parent is the current master.

completion.summary: Delivered in exact 469fc786e1f6d18acd5722fef1b12a052347c4d5/tree e1bd6e009aa81312af96468e2178e1dba2c893e1. Bind admitted GCM store to the launched transport and refuse unbound/cache stores, correlate foreground and drained cleanup by controller identity, select the Unix controller only on macOS/Linux, and render plain optional OS error numbers. Strict locked Clippy and focused regressions passed on Windows (16), macOS (32, 2 ignored fixtures) and Linux (33, 2 ignored fixtures). All five criteria independently passed in 4acf525885f042ff9ecdcb8fa03e7756. Exact candidate and native artifacts held for parent E′ integration per parent note 61e14b4d465d474b91e1e54a78b93f8c.
